gameName: Five Tribes: The Djinns of Naqala
editionLabel: Days of Wonder English base game
firstPlayerRule: Randomly place the turn markers on the Bid Order track. The marker in position 1 bids first; after bidding, the highest bid takes the first action turn.
officialTieBreak: Positive bids must use different spaces. Among zero bids, the last marker placed acts first; the first zero bidder acts last.
clarifications: With two players, each player uses two turn markers and takes two action turns per round.
Bidding is repeated each round. Initial bid order does not by itself determine who takes the first action.
